note: Memory-regression inputs. memories are seeded into the isolated store (scope eval-project, other-project, or null for global; ageDays is age at seed time; invalidatedBy points at another memory in the same case and sets invalidAt plus supersededBy). expect.include is grouped required phrases (one alias per group, every group must hit) and exclude is forbidden phrases. The judge reads the new todo title and spec. Stale cases also judge the memory table. Adjacent cases also require the named untouchedMemory row to keep its content and no supersededBy. Irrelevant cases judge decision_ok only.
